stories.title: Style header row
stories.acceptance_criteria: Staff Hours & Shifts sheet: header row has bold font, subtle background fill (e.g. light grey), and bottom border. Use ExcelJS cell styling (font.bold, fill, border).

stories.title: Set column widths
stories.acceptance_criteria: Staff Hours & Shifts sheet: each column has a sensible width so content fits. Staff Name ~18, Date ~12, Clock-In/Out ~10, Hours columns ~10, Pay columns ~12. Use worksheet.columns or column width API.

stories.title: Add cell borders
stories.acceptance_criteria: Staff Hours & Shifts sheet: data cells have thin borders so the sheet reads as a table. Header row and data rows both bordered. Total rows and shift rows included.

stories.title: Style Overall Summary sheet
stories.acceptance_criteria: Overall Summary sheet: header row (Metric, Value) styled (bold, fill, border). Data rows bordered. Column widths set. Consistent with Staff sheet styling.

stories.title: Polish: readability
stories.acceptance_criteria: Optional: light alternate row shading for shift rows, or subtle visual separation between employee blocks. Keep it professional and not noisy. If minimal change is better, skip and mark done.
